context_requirements: IR40a is an insect chemosensory ionotropic receptor with no known human ortholog
Human cells lack the IR40a receptor and its downstream signaling components
No human target or pathway is known to be engaged by IR40a activators
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent transcriptional changes in multiple human cell lines at 6 h or 24 h
Shared gene expression signature across the nine lines that is not explained by vehicle or general toxicity
Evidence of a human ionotropic receptor or related pathway being modulated by the compound class
